title: MADE WITH LOVE, PIXELS & GRATITUDE

entries.name: 0x72
entries.work: DungeonTileset II — our knight, the goblins, shamans, ogres, every wall and floor of this cave
entries.thanks: the beating heart of this dungeon. thank you for giving it away so freely.

entries.name: CraftPix.net
entries.work: Free Top-Down Orc Characters — the grunt, the blademaster, the general, in all four directions
entries.thanks: three magnificent orcs that march, swing and fall with style.

entries.name: Claude
entries.work: Warchief, Butcher, Shaman King, Nun, Quasimodo, berserkers, campfire, cards, whip, scythe & effects
entries.thanks: drawn pixel by pixel, just for this cave.

entries.name: Kenney
entries.work: Tiny Dungeon pack — our trusty backup that never had to fight
entries.thanks: the patron saint of game jams everywhere.

entries.name: WebAudio synth
entries.work: every slash, gem, roar and the ambient cave loop — generated live, no files
entries.thanks: four oscillators in a trench coat.

entries.name: OpenGameArt community
entries.work: researched CC0 packs by Juhani Junkala, rubberduck & friends (see docs/AUDIO.md)
entries.thanks: a treasure cave of libre sound, waiting for our next update.

entries.name: Brotato
entries.work: by Blobfish — the wave-and-shop loop this game lovingly borrows
entries.thanks: a potato showed us the way.

entries.name: You
entries.work: for playing, for slashing, for sitting by our little fire
entries.thanks: the cave is warmer with you in it.

outro: …and to every orc that fell so this game could live. WAAAGH!
